arguments.command:
git add -A && git commit -q -F - <<'EOF'
fix: keep a run's thread refs out of refs/pi/ and report failed sessions

A run stored refs/pi/threads/<n> under that same name locally, so a fetch
into refs/pi/* by the agent (git fetch origin '+refs/pi/*:refs/pi/*', as in
the run on #46) moved the ref under GitStorage. The next commit's
compare-and-swap failed, pi-durable failed the session, and the trigger was
dropped with only a log warning: no reply, no reaction, a green step.

- The run now keeps the thread and its working-tree snapshots on
  refs/pi-action/{threads,worktrees}/<n> and pushes them to their refs/pi/
  names on the remote (GitSync's localRef and localCompanionRef).
- A trigger whose wait throws gets a pi Error comment with the cause chain
  and a confused reaction, and the step fails.
- The always() step treats a local ref the remote already contains as
  saved, not as a rejected push.

Refs #46
EOF
timeout 120 git push -q -u origin fix/46-session-storage-failure 2>&1 | tail -3
timeout 120 gh pr create --title "fix: keep a run's thread refs out of refs/pi/ and report failed sessions" --body "$(cat <<'EOF'
Fixes the failed run investigated in #46 (https://github.com/cv/pi-action/actions/runs/43174544345).

## What happened
The agent ran `git fetch origin '+refs/pi/*:refs/pi/*'`. That force-reset the local `refs/pi/threads/46`, which is the ref the run's `GitStorage` was writing. The next compare-and-swap commit failed, pi-durable failed the session, and `ThreadConversation.track()` logged a warning and dropped the trigger. Result: no reply, no reaction, and a green step. The `Save pi thread state` step then tried to push the rewound ref and warned "another writer moved it".

## Changes
- **Local refs outside `refs/pi/`.** A run keeps `refs/pi/threads/<n>` on `refs/pi-action/threads/<n>`, and `refs/pi/worktrees/<n>` on `refs/pi-action/worktrees/<n>`. It pushes them to their `refs/pi/` names on the remote. `GitSync` gets `localRef` and `localCompanionRef`, and `liveRef()` maps the names. `push.ts` reads the local names.
- **Failed sessions are reported.** If waiting for an answer throws, pi-action posts a `❌ pi Error` comment with the full cause chain (e.g. `Session failed after a storage error…: Git storage is poisoned…: Ref … moved…`) and adds 😕. The step fails with `setFailed`.
- **`push.ts`:** if the remote already contains the local tip, the step logs `already saved` instead of a warning.
- Docs: `threads.md` (Protection against conflicts) and `how-it-works.md`.

## Tests
- An agent that fetches into `refs/pi/*` and deletes `refs/pi/threads/42` mid-run still gets its answer posted and pushed.
- An agent that deletes the live ref gets an error comment, 😕, and `setFailed`.
- The always() step leaves a remote that is ahead alone.
- `GitSync` fetches into its own local refs and clears them.

Not included: reopening the session automatically after a storage failure. See the discussion on #46.

`npm run check` passes.
EOF
)" 2>&1 | tail -2
